Anatomy of ASSIST

Four verticals,
one incubator

Every incubatee draws on all four arms of ASSIST - from the lab bench to the market.

Research & Development

Applied research support that turns student and faculty ideas into working prototypes.

Tech & Innovation

Engineering mentorship, tooling and technical infrastructure for building real products.

Media and Design

Brand, story and design craft so every venture communicates as well as it builds.

Strategic Partnership

Industry, investor and institutional connections that open doors beyond the campus.

Leadership

People behind
the platform

The leadership guiding VSSUT ASSIST and its growing community of ventures.

ASSIST / CEO
MM
01 / Leadership
Chief Executive Officer

Manoranjan Mohapatra

Entrepreneur, investor and mentor focused on building Odisha's startup ecosystem.

Brings 15+ years of C-level experience across India and Singapore, including work with L&T, ICLC and BPL. He co-founded Exilant Technologies in Bhubaneswar and Singapore, with Apple as a client; Exilant was later acquired by Quest Global.

Over the past decade, he has supported Odisha startups through seed investment and mentoring, including Final Mile, DATOMs, Aurassure, VillaMart, Mo Ambulance, Foreign Admits, Realogist and Moodmigo. He previously served as Director, IC and Consultant with BPUT.

BSc Electrical Engineering · OUTR (formerly CET, Bhubaneswar) / MBA · XIMB
